coverImageAlt: Ava, Gabriel, and Harrow shelter among abandoned vehicles at moonrise
summary: Night forces the group to shelter before the hospital is reached. Around a guarded fire, exhaustion loosens old memories while trust remains rationed as carefully as supplies.
seoTitle: Shadows of the Past | Ava: Sporelight
metaDescription: A dangerous night halt draws out grief, suspicion, and uneasy dependence as the hospital mission stalls in the ruins.
